justification: Plain-English floor/ceiling labels on the capacity card's dwelling-yield range. The engine-side LMR ceiling uplift is already built and firing (_lmr_uplift_form -> _realistic_forms, both brief paths); the gap was the label jargon. Replaces 'as-of-right' and 'subject to a DA' with 'without council approval' / 'with council approval', and retitles the cell 'Homes you could build'.

pre_impl.existing_data: Verified live: _lmr_uplift_form fires (R2->dual_occupancy, R3->multi_dwelling_housing) and _realistic_forms raises the ceiling above the base zone tier; both streaming and non-streaming brief paths pass uplift_form. The card already received as_of_right_dwellings + max_permitted_dwellings.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The number range was correct but labelled in planning jargon ('as-of-right', 'subject to a DA') a layperson cannot parse.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data or component. Rewords the existing Dwelling Yield cell; no logic change to the floor/ceiling values.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No fetching. Pure presentation of values already in the result.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: '1 as-of-right; up to 3 (multi dwelling housing) subject to a DA'. After: 'Homes you could build 1-3 — 1 without council approval, up to 3 (multi dwelling housing) with council approval.'

values: N/A - no regulatory values; the floor/ceiling counts are unchanged engine outputs, only relabelled.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.
